episode.title: How I Reversed My Type 2 Diabetes

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Dogmas and the Sugar Lobby

episode.tagline: Everything that we were taught about nutrition and diabetes back in the day was wrong. Today we know that sugar is poison and fat is fine. And that Type 2 diabetes can be reversed.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit talks about how he reversed his Type 2 Diabetes -- and along the way, he tells us the history of how the Sugar Lobby of America shaped a dangerous consensus that led to the Obesity Epidemic. The key part in Amit's understanding what food does to our bodies was using a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) -- something that Ajay recommended to him. Ajay discusses his nuanced learnings about food from using the CGM. Their recommendations include essential books about Indian and Soviet politics -- a great diet for the brain!
